how: Logical size (cli.md 6.2): an `[f64]` of 1,000 is 16 + 1,000 x (16 + 8) = 24,016 bytes. `array.repeat` makes one (24,016 made; its `none` error and the `i32` of `array.len` are far too small to change the count). In each iteration `b` (`array.set`) comes before `l` (`array.len`) in the global order (spec 8; canonical order of the body, 5.2: `b` before `l` by name), so when `array.set` runs, `xs` is still to be read by `array.len`: its read is not the last, it copies (D-11; cli.md 6.2, `--max-made`), and makes 24,016 bytes. The totals are 48,032, 72,048, 96,064 after iterations 0, 1 and 2, then 120,080 in iteration 3, past 100,000: the fault `LC8009` at the node `b`, in iteration 3 of the loop `a` (named by its first output, commands.md 8), at 0 ms, with no output. The statement of `b` is line 10 of copies.lcf and starts at column 9, after eight spaces.
